name: iter_baseline
description: The reference trajectory: the companion paper's operating point (n_bumps 5, noise 0.05, radius 0.25, iters_initial 12, n_train 100, sel_sigma 0.5, mix_ratio 0.5, n_select 100, iters_retrain 400, warm-start) run as a LOOP instead of a single round, over 8 iterations and 10 seeds, in the FOCUSED new-only regime: every round continues training on just that round's newly selected points, which is exactly the paper's own retraining protocol repeated. Answers whether the guided advantage survives repetition under the protocol that punishes over-concentration hardest. NOTE: seed-to-seed spread of the across-loop gap is large in this regime (sd ~0.3), so 10 seeds gives a standard error near 0.09 — read the confidence bands, and raise the seed count before claiming a small effect. Detector trio = the strongest and most diverse at this anchor.
